title: Container Bookings: containers on which a customer roll fee is charged
content:
## Rule
A customer roll fee on a Container Bookings booking is charged only on the containers the line will move. Containers covered by the booking's dangerous-goods acceptance that the line has rejected do not travel and are left out, so the chargeable containers are the booking's container count less the container count of that rejected acceptance, never below zero. A booking on which more than one dangerous-goods acceptance has been rejected falls outside the customer roll fee rules, because its chargeable containers are not defined by them.

The rejected status and the container count come from the booking's dangerous-goods acceptance record.

## Cases (hypothetical counts)
- Booking of 6 containers, no rejected acceptance: 6 chargeable containers.
- Booking of 6 containers, one rejected acceptance covering 2: 4 chargeable containers.
- Booking of 6 containers, one rejected acceptance covering 8: 0 chargeable containers, since the result is never below zero.
- Booking with two rejected acceptances: not defined by these rules.

*All figures are hypothetical inputs, for illustration only.*
